name: plan-add-single-target-and-empty-clear-marker
body: The CLI exposes a single --target destination shared by every renames/moves operation edge, and clearing a task's operation set on update relies on the bare --target "" supplied-empty marker (the only way task_operations_supplied sees a replace-with-nothing). Limits: one shared destination, and an empty-clear that rides the --target flag. Upgrade: add per-edge destinations and an explicit clear flag when the CLI needs them.
